title: Far Horizons
author: SwedenJohansson
summary: Few islands, far apart: a volcano, a frozen peak, a rat marsh and a last haven, each kilometres from the next.
description:
Random islands are off: after 2 km a volcano glows on the horizon, after 6 km a frozen spire rises, after 10 km a misty marsh full of rats, and after 15 km a quiet atoll - the last haven. Between them there is only the sea, so plan your supplies.
Best with Fierce monsters and a higher build cost (World settings).
